name: bu_Zn12O12
title: ZnO (Zn12O12) crystal
description: Crystal structure prediction of ZnO with 12 formula units (24 atoms) per cell. The experimental ground state wurtzite (P6_3mc) is also the NEP89 global minimum; the nearly degenerate tetrahedral stacking polytypes (4H +5, zinc blende +7 meV/atom) and rocksalt (+47 meV/atom) are competing minima.
